plainTranslation: Identity under pressure from the other's limits or authority. One feels blocked or judged; the other feels responsible for reining them in. Failure mode: resentment dressed as respect, or control dressed as care. Push on what genuinely needs structure and drop the rest; don't let it become one person managing the other.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their caution presses on your confidence, and you feel checked. They can ground you or dim you. Ask whether their limit is care or control, and answer that.
tension: At its worst, the lesson gets distorted. You keep trying to prove yourself. They keep finding flaws. Instead of learning responsibility, you learn self-doubt. Instead of building confidence, you become preoccupied with what is wrong with you. The question is whether the challenge is teaching you to trust yourself more or less.
advice: A healthy Sun-Saturn square helps you develop strength, accountability, and self-respect. An unhealthy one leaves you believing that no matter what you do, you will never be enough.
